patterns.note: A three-column layout is consistently used for content pages, featuring a fixed left-hand navigation, a central scrolling content area, and a fixed right-hand 'On this page' navigation.
Clear sans-serif typography with bold, distinct headings for section hierarchy, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels for contextual navigation and metadata.
A predominantly neutral palette (white, grays) is accented by two distinct, vibrant colors: a bright red/orange for primary links and CTAs, and a softer purple for secondary icons and highlights.
The main header shrinks significantly in height and its elements reposition as the user scrolls down, while both the left-hand and right-hand navigation sidebars remain fixed in the viewport.
Content sections are introduced by clear, bold headings and often feature supporting icons or bulleted lists, maintaining a consistent visual rhythm and readability.

technique_notes: The main header dynamically reduces its height and repositions its internal elements (logo, search bar) as the user scrolls down the page, creating a compact sticky header. The left and right navigation sidebars are implemented as fixed elements, ensuring they remain visible and accessible regardless of scroll depth.
A video player is embedded directly into the hero section to provide a dynamic visual introduction to the product, playing automatically without scroll-triggered animation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced hierarchy with clear, bold headings (approx 2-3x body text) and readable body text, complemented by small uppercase labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and the video player frame.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, creating an airy and readable layout.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the highly structured three-column layout with two fixed sidebars for navigation, which provides an exceptionally clear and persistent navigational context, especially effective for documentation or feature-rich product pages.
